Messages.Author: Joscha
Messages.Body:
Al should be able to get blood back to summon more 'histories'. After one Remnant he is more or less empty, even with the Ankara Citadel. The Coven? Heidelberg Castle to give him blood from your other minions?
Bleed defence? No bounce/bleed reducing with AUS? That seems dangerous to me.
What about at least three or so Agent of Powers for the little ones?

Baron of Frankfurt

Messages.Author: Boris The Blade
Messages.Body:
> Ohlmann wrote:
> It's called Black Hand S&B  I believe Izaak made something like that with !assamite.
>
No, I was talking of a Summon History deck with only a couple of Summon History, since Art of Memory can replace the remaining ones. I have played against the Sargon Fragment version and the setup is far too heavy to work. Compared to Sargon Fragment, Art of Memory saves an action and a blood per SH played.

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
> Non-existant user wrote:
> No, I was talking of a Summon History deck with only a couple of Summon History, since Art of Memory can replace the remaining ones.
>
You need more than Art of Memory for that, since your main problem will be to fetch the summons. If you have 2 summon in the decks, you'd better not rely on it or have good way to retrieve them.

As have said Derjudge, you may use Sybil Tongue (and !Malkavian), or Drop Point Network (which may not be all that effective). It may need, in addition to the retrievings cards, some telepathic misdirection since you would take longer to start your army.

Else, you may cut the deck to 60 card and only need 4-6 summon history. Far easier said than done.

> Ohlmann wrote:
